value.content: {"id": "portswigger_access_control", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "access_control", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: Broken Access Control & IDOR", "name": "Broken Access Control & Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-639", "owasp_category": "A01:2021 - Broken Access Control", "signals": ["horizontal_privilege_escalation", "vertical_privilege_escalation", "unprotected_admin_panel", "role_header_tampering", "insecure_direct_object_reference", "verb_tampering"], "verification_strategy": "Perform dual-session differential testing: request protected resource of User A using session token of User B (horizontal escalation), and request administrative functionality using unauthenticated or low-privilege tokens (vertical escalation). Test HTTP verb tampering (GET vs POST vs PUT).", "evidence_requirements": ["cross_tenant_data_disclosure", "unauthorized_admin_access_proof", "status_200_under_low_privilege"], "tools": [{"tool": "IDORSkill", "cmd": "IDORSkill.run(url, param='user_id')", "desc": "Cross-tenant identity permutation and matrix differential evaluator"}, {"tool": "BurpAgent (AuthMatrix / Autorize)", "cmd": "Autorize.audit_endpoint(request, session_b)", "desc": "Automated dual-context HTTP request replaying and response comparison"}], "remediation": "Adopt a 'deny by default' access control policy. Enforce object-level access control checks on every server request verifying that the authenticated user owns or has explicit permission for the requested entity.", "description": "PortSwigger Access Control labs analyze unlinked admin URLs, header-based role overrides (X-Original-URL, X-Rewrite-URL), insecure IDOR parameters in profile endpoints, and multi-step workflow authorization flaws."}
